name: ReSpeaker XVF3800 USB 4-Mic Array
description: Seeed ReSpeaker 4-mic circular array driven by the XMOS XVF3800 DSP. The DSP does beamforming, de-reverberation, acoustic echo cancellation and direction-of-arrival on-device, so the host receives one already-cleaned mono stream rather than four raw capsules.

meta.notes: Enumerates as a UAC composite device: one capture stream, one playback stream, plus a vendor-specific control interface used for device management. No kernel driver is needed for audio.
